<nowiki />
|translation='''Title:''' Major Praji.

'''Card text:''' Where Praji is present, C-3PO and R2-D2 cannot use their card rules. Any starship he pilots is power +2. When aboard the Devastator, hyperspeed is +1.

'''Lore:''' Served as Vader's aide aboard the warship Devastator. On Vader's orders, directed the search for the Death Star plans on Tatooine. Graduated with excellent results from the Imperial Navy Academy on Carida.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title uses the rank “major” (少佐); the English title uses “commander.” The Japanese text joins C-3PO and R2-D2 with “and,” while the English face uses “or.”
